claim: Apple's fiscal 2025 revenue of $416.2 billion was generated in the fourth quarter.
summary: Apple's full-year fiscal 2025 revenue was ~$416.2B, but Q4 was only ~$102.5B. Claiming the $416.2B was generated in the fourth quarter is false.

sub_claims.text: Apple's fiscal 2025 total revenue was $416.2 billion.
sub_claims.note: From model knowledge Apple reported full-year FY2025 revenue of approximately $416.2 billion.

sub_claims.text: The $416.2 billion was generated in the fourth quarter, i.e. Q4 revenue was $416.2 billion.
sub_claims.stated_text: was generated in the fourth quarter
sub_claims.note: Full-year total was ~$416.2B; Q4 FY2025 revenue was ~$102.5B, so $416.2B was not generated in the fourth quarter alone.
